# optimizelycmssaas_content (Resource)

A content item and the current version of one locale. Updating a published version creates a new version; set publish = true to publish it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "optimizelycmssaas_content_root" "this" {}

resource "optimizelycmssaas_content" "start" {
  content_type = optimizelycmssaas_content_type.article.key
  container    = data.optimizelycmssaas_content_root.this.key
  locale       = "en"
  display_name = "Welcome"

  properties_json = jsonencode({
    heading = { value = "Hello" }
  })

  publish          = false # set true to publish after each apply
  permanent_delete = true  # remove for good on destroy
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_type` (String) Content type key. Cannot be changed.
- `display_name` (String) Name of the content item in this locale.

### Optional

- `blueprint` (String) Blueprint key to create from. Create-only; not returned by the API.
- `container` (String) Key of the parent content item. Can be changed to move the item.
- `key` (String) Content key; generated by the CMS when omitted. Cannot be changed.
- `locale` (String) BCP-47 locale of this version. Cannot be changed.
- `owner` (String) Key of the owning content item (for assets).
- `permanent_delete` (Boolean) Delete permanently on destroy instead of moving to the CMS's recoverable deleted state.
- `properties_json` (String) JSON object of property values keyed by property name (use jsonencode); each value is wrapped as {value = ...}, e.g. {title = {value = "Hello"}}. Drift is detected structurally; fields the API adds as defaults are ignored.
- `publish` (Boolean) Publish the version after each apply. Publishing is one-way: setting this back to false does not unpublish.
- `route_segment` (String) URL segment; generated when omitted.
- `simple_route` (String) Shortcut URL for pages and experiences.

### Read-Only

- `reference` (String) The item as a content reference, cms://content/<key>. Use as an application's `entry_point`.
- `status` (String) Status of the managed version, e.g. draft, published.
- `version` (String) Identifier of the managed version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Primary locale:
terraform import optimizelycmssaas_content.start 2fa42d46916244e8968cc0127dbd579c
# A specific locale:
terraform import optimizelycmssaas_content.start 2fa42d46916244e8968cc0127dbd579c/sv
```
